dynamic_line.no: Well here and now I am the law, and the law here is that people purchase my goods, they take them out into the world and they die; or they return to buy more of my goods.  Either way, I write poetry about them.
dynamic_line.yes: Once I was lost in the throes of love, now I've built an empire of material goods.  I've found these two things are equally as powerful, and dangerous.
